id: Moon Jam Nite-MOON, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Moon Jam Nite
long_description:
Get your 15 minutes of fame at Newtown's famous Moon Jam Nite, every Tuesday from 7.30pm

The evening starts off as a regular open mic, and transforms into a full on jam towards the end.

Put your moniker into the sign up sheet, and own your time slot. You can call upon the many talented muso's available to help you play your slot.

A full stage with electric guitar, bass, keyboard, drums, mics, lights and full support from our sound tech.

Bring your own songs, poems, and friends (and make some new ones too)

id: Jazz Festival: Tribute To Paul Desmond And Chet Baker-The Undercurrent, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Jazz Festival: Tribute To Paul Desmond And Chet Baker
long_description:
As part of Wellington Jazz Festival, The Undercurrent presents a Tribute to Paul Desmond & Chet Baker!

Enter a world of entrancingly elegant Jazz. Leave your worries behind as you listen to the mastery of Paul Desmond and Chet Baker being played through Cameron and Sylvester and hear the sweet tones of Jim Hall come to life via the ever incredible Sascha Huny. Supported by the incredible Jago Watson on bass and Aaron McDaniel on Drums, you are in for an evening of a beautiful mix of classic jazz tunes (with a twist) and some lesser known bangers. Come along, relax at the Undercurrent and enjoy the music.

Wednesday Oct 14
Doors 6pm
Music 6:30pm
$15 ($10 students)

Tickets available online and at the door!

Snacks, a range of refreshing drinks, tea & coffee, and of course...books available for purchase!

We’ll see you there ☆

id: Jazz Festival: Hupstein Eng And Friends-The Undercurrent, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Jazz Festival: Hupstein Eng And Friends
long_description:
As part of Wellington Jazz Festival, The Undercurrent presents Hupstein Eng and Friends!

Join Upper Hutt guitarist and vocalist Hupstein Eng and an all-star band for an evening of swinging vocal jazz inspired by the timeless music of Frank Sinatra, Nat King Cole, and Chet Baker. Featuring Freddy Sayer (piano), Jacob Meikle (bass), Aaron McDaniel (drums), and special guests, the group brings the Great American Songbook to life with bouncy swing, lyrical improvisation, and playful musical interaction. Expect fresh takes on beloved jazz standards, plenty of spontaneity, and an intimate performance that celebrates the joy of live jazz.

Music 5pm
$20 ($15 unwaged)

id: Jazz Festival: The David Fromont Quintet-The Undercurrent, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Jazz Festival: The David Fromont Quintet
long_description:
As part of Wellington Jazz Festival, The Undercurrent presents The David Fromont Quintet!

Coming down from Auckland, it's the David Fromont Quintet!

David Fromont is a young trombonist from the city of sails making his Wellington Jazz Festival debut this year with his jazz quintet. Having an ear for everything, David will be putting on original compositions and classic jazz arrangements while mixing experimental trombone explorations and true-to-tradition jazz quintet playing. Featuring in his band is Samuel Voyle on the saxophone, Ryan Tomov on the piano, Finn McNeill on the drums, and Minjoon Kim on the bass.

Expect the unexpected (and a little of the expected as well!) with the David Fromont Quintet at Undercurrent.

id: Rivering: Original Compositions By Lily Rose Atu-Thistle Hall, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Rivering: Original Compositions By Lily Rose Atu
long_description:
Lily Rose Atu recently finished studying Jazz at the NZ School of Music, and is excited to share her original works. This collection of music is an observation that we are in constant motion, occupying different spaces throughout time, moving, transforming and streaming, as a river would. This collection has been developed over the past few years, inspired by her love for jazz and neo-soul. This is the last album fundraising gig before the band goes into recording in late October of this year! Your support would be so incredible!

This music will be brought to life by the magical and marvelous: Jono Ben Zur on bass, Paulina Hernandez on piano, Ranu Wijesuriya on drums, Elisa Bird on baritone, Frank Paton on trumpet, Victoria Ferry on vocals, and Lily Rose Atu on saxophone and vocals.

Doors: 8:30pm
* Alcohol free event
* Wheelchair accessible venue

id: Louis TM (Jazz Festival)-MOON, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Louis TM (Jazz Festival)
long_description:
The good reverend of R&B and soothsayer of soul LOUIS TM presents an intimate festival performance celebrating the enduring connection between soul, jazz and gospel. Having joined the cast of Aotearoa supergroup FLY MY PRETTIES and years of backing some of the country's leading artists, he brings his unique style of soul to the stage.

Soul music has always shared its roots with jazz—born from improvisation, storytelling and raw emotion. In this special Wellington Jazz Festival performance, he brings those traditions together in an intimate evening of original music and timeless soul classics - a night not to be missed!

Louis TM is a force to be reckoned with on Aotearoa's incredible soul scene - Muzic.net.nz

It’s as if the whole crowd exhaled at once... Louis transported us to a space of hope and togetherness - bFM review.

name: Mark Lockett Trio
long_description:
The Mark Lockett Trio brings together three of New Zealand’s most exciting jazz voices. With Mark Lockett on drums, Daniel Yeabsley on bass and Dan Hayles on piano, this trio reimagines standards from the Great American Songbook with energy, playfulness, and heart.

id: Jazz Festival: B.R.O.A.T. Quartet (An Evening Of Clowncore)-The Undercurrent, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Jazz Festival: B.R.O.A.T. Quartet (An Evening Of Clowncore)
long_description:
As part of Wellington Jazz Festival, The Undercurrent presents B.R.O.A.T. Quartet: An Evening of Clowncore!

B.R.O.A.T. is a quartet with a focus on expansive, rock and pop infused jazz music. For one evening only, we are bringing you a selection of music written by the mysterious duo known as Clowncore and arranged by saxophonist Finn Grieve. Joining Finn is Julia Ramsay on keys, Max Stopyra on bass and Ned Rainey on the drums. Expect danceable grooves, driving energy and a healthy amount of swing thrown in with the chaotic beats and abrasive textures of Clowncore's delightful musical body of work. A night of familiar antics complete with a new face of makeup.

id: Jazz Festival: Cranberry Trio At Undercurrent Books-The Undercurrent, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Jazz Festival: Cranberry Trio At Undercurrent Books
long_description:
As part of Wellington Jazz Festival, The Undercurrent presents Cranberry Trio!

Cranberry Trio are a Tāmaki Makaurau/Auckland based trio made up of Iggy Nama Ruci (alto saxophone), Ryan Tomov (upright bass), and Finn McNeill (drums). 

The group have an exciting and original style shaped by their years of playing together, their shared musical influences and philosophies and an interest in exploring collective improvisation, rhythmic complexity and melodic interplay. Influenced by the sounds and theories of Ornette Coleman (most notably his theory of harmolodics), Anthony Braxton, John & Alice Coltrane and Derek Bailey - The Cranberry Trio will present a set entirely made up of their original compositions, some unearthed for the first time for curious ears to discover - at Undercurrent Books this Wellington Jazz Festival! 

Thursday Oct 15
Doors 6pm
Music 6:30pm
$20 ($10 students)

Tickets available online and at the door!

Snacks, a range of refreshing drinks, tea & coffee, and of course...books available for purchase!

We’ll see you there ☆

id: Jazz Festival: John Rae's BOP-IT!-The Undercurrent, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Jazz Festival: John Rae's BOP-IT!
long_description:
As part of Wellington Jazz Festival, The Undercurrent presents John Rae’s BOP-IT!

John Rae’s BOP-IT! returns to the festival after last year's sell-out concert that had the crowd going wild.

Featuring a stellar lineup of Aotearoa’s finest jazz musicians, John Rae’s BOP-IT! delivers a high-energy celebration of the hard bop era. Rooted in the rich traditions of 1950s and 60s jazz, BOP-IT! brings new life to classic repertoire while exploring the bold, boundary-pushing spirit of post-bop.

With virtuosic solos, driving rhythms, and deep grooves, this will be one of the most exhilarating performances of the festival. Hard bop has always challenged both audiences and musicians alike—and BOP-IT! takes it to the next level.

id: Album Release | Oscar Lavën 'Flamingovision'-Rogue and Vagabond, Wellington -Under The Radar
name: Album Release | Oscar Lavën 'Flamingovision'
long_description:
His improvisations consistently reveal an immersion in the tradition balanced with a fearless, joyful and searching personality of his own.” - UK Jazz News

After releasing his last album 'Elegant Calamity' to a sold-out crowd at last Wellington Jazz Festival, flamboyant saxophonist Oscar Lavën makes his return to the Rogue and Vagabond this festival to release a brand new album, 'Flamingovision'.

Oscar Lavën has played with many notable artists such as John Beasley's MONKestra, Steve Gadd, James Carter, Dave Weckl, Peter Erskine, Lalah Hathaway, Clay Jenkins and more. His effervescent style draws on an eclectic musical background of early swing music, New Orleans traditional, straight-ahead, spiritual jazz, classical music, blues, and 50s bar-walking rock and roll sax.

Prepare for a colourful, kaleidoscopic performance featuring Duncan Haynes (piano), John Rae (drums), Michael Taylor (trumpet) and Patrick Bleakley (double bass) as they play through the album live in an exciting release of new original New Zealand music.

$15 online, $20 on the door

Part of the Wellington Jazz Festival 2026
